hero_desc: From database design to the last screen, I deliver complete business systems for growing companies — and I currently lead a development team at A One Salasar Pvt Ltd, Thane.
about_p1: I'm a Senior Software Developer & Team Lead at A One Salasar Pvt Ltd, Thane, with 4+ years of professional experience. Based in Airoli, Navi Mumbai, I build scalable web applications using Laravel and CodeIgniter 4, and lead a team delivering business software.
about_p2: From multi-company CRMs to full eCommerce platforms and ERP solutions, I deliver end-to-end products that solve real business problems — with third-party API integrations, payment gateways, mobile APIs and, most recently, AI voice assistants.
